title: Syria Narrative Tracker: what is being said about Syria online
description: An automatically updated dataset and website following public online discussion about Syria: public posts in Arabic, Kurdish and English from Telegram channels, news feeds, YouTube comments, Reddit and X, grouped by a language model into stories filed under fixed themes, with the tone of people's reactions and of outlet coverage, per theme, per language and per kind of outlet. The archive (data/archive) holds every analysis since 11 September 2026 and the outlet headlines; monthly CSV and JSON tables are under data/exports; the method, sources and the exact analysis instructions are in data/methodology.json and on the website's About page. Individuals' posts are never stored.
